title: Enable bluetooth and try again
body:
I have a problem with recognition Dexcom MT by the Xdrip+ . It says error: Enable bluetooth and try again. Bluetooth is turned on, it worked properly one month and yesterday stopped. The phone I use is Huawei CUN-21L (YP II) and I cleared all the cash and data related to the Bluetooth application. 

Could it be from the Dexcom transmitter, I can not awake it in any way and Xdrip can not find it. Also tried with Samsung Galaxy S8+.

Thank you in advance for any comments.
